question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The word "unpunished" fits best in this context because it implies that evil deeds, no matter how they are performed, will not go without consequence. This aligns with the passage's message that good actions are rewarded, and bad actions are punished.
 
• Other options such as "vile" or "punished" don't fit grammatically or contextually in the sentence, as the phrase "vile deeds never go" lacks coherence and "punished" doesn't match the structure.

 

Correct Sentence: *"Honesty and hard work never go unrewarded and unpunished __and evil deeds never go unrewarded."*
